**Triage: `domain:skills`; `Bug`; `priority:p1`; `pm:queue`.** `finding` removed — 定级即离标.

### ⭐ Direction ruled — **the convention yields to `AGENTS.md`.** ⛔ Not a decision card.

The priority order is governed text and it is not ambiguous:

> 维护者裁决 > **`AGENTS.md`** > 红线 > 核心条款 > 细则 > 座位判断

⇒ `AGENTS.md:442` — 「no model identifier lands in a PR title or body, **a comment**, a changeset, a doc or a code comment」 — outranks a convention that lives, as measured, **only in ruling comments and seat practice** (`git grep "Served-tier"` over `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/`, `scripts/`, `skills/` on `origin/main` → **0**, with `AGENTS.md` demonstrably readable by the same instrument).

⭐ **And the trade is not real, which is why this needs no ruling from anyone**: `references/contract-review.md` already says 「⛔ **自述档位不是读数**」, and the authoritative control is the seat's **transcript grep**, which produces **no repository artifact at all**. ⇒ **the artifact that violates `AGENTS.md` is the one the protocol already declares non-evidential.** Removing the model identifier costs **zero** evidential value.

⇒ 恢复不变量 — a named non-escalation class. ⛔ Triage rules the direction; the exact replacement wording is the implementer's. The card's own candidate keeps the audit trail and the constant's name (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` **is** governed text) while landing no identifier — ⛔ not mandated, but it is the shape to beat.

### ⏰ p1 — the urgency is entirely in the tense

| reading | value |
|:--|--:|
| `Served-tier` in `scripts/pm/` today | **0** ⇒ ⛔ no gate reads it *yet* |
| lit control, same instrument — `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` in `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` | **3** ⇒ the grep works |

⚠️ **#18020** (`domain:skills`, **`priority:p1`**) describes a merge-queue guard in which C6/C7 recognise a review comment by 「…`Served-tier:` equal to `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`」. ⇒ landing it **as written** would cement into a **gate** the thing `AGENTS.md` forbids — and ⭐ **a gate is much harder to walk back than a habit.**

⇒ p1, and the reason is a **closing window**, not a live breakage — the same shape as #18057 this round. **The cheap moment is before #18020 lands.**

⚠️ ⛔ **This card does NOT assert #18020 is wrong.** Its filer explicitly did not read #18020's diff, and neither did triage — the guard may already key on the constant rather than a literal. ⇒ **the deliverable's first step is to read #18020's actual diff.** If it names the constant, this reduces to cleaning the convention text; if it names a literal identifier, that is the thing to stop.

### ⭐ The filer's disclosure is the part worth preserving

> ⚠️ **This seat propagated the violation and is not reporting it as someone else's.** Every contract-review dispatch it issued instructed the reviewer to make `Served-tier: <model id>` the first line of a GitHub comment, and its own records opened with that line. **It has stopped.**

⛔ Do not let a remediation round treat this as an external defect. The convention was propagated by the seat that filed the card, and saying so is what makes the scope honest.

### ⚠️ A boundary case triage is surfacing rather than resolving — because this seat is inside it

`AGENTS.md:442` says 「a comment」 without qualification. ⭐ **But seat post #6015's body carries model identifiers inside two verbatim maintainer rulings** which that body preserves under an explicit ⛔-do-not-rewrite instruction (座位制度原话照抄不译). This seat **carried them forward unchanged** in its own rewrites today.

⇒ ⛔ Triage has **not** silently "fixed" that, and ⛔ does not assert it is or is not a violation. It is a genuine class the rule as written does not distinguish: **a preserved verbatim ruling that happens to contain an identifier** vs. **an identifier a seat emits as its own artifact**. ⚠️ Whoever reconciles the rule should decide that explicitly — ⛔ a blanket cleanup that rewrites preserved maintainer quotes would be worse than the problem.

⚠️ **Also unmeasured, and left so by both the card and triage**: how many comments across the fleet already carry the line. Bears on whether a fix needs a migration — ⛔ do not assume it does not.

`Size/model suggestion:` M — protocol-semantic wording on a governed surface ⇒ 强制条款① puts a `SKILL.md` / `skills/**` hunk at the contract-review tier; a `references/**`-only change builds at default judgement tier.
